reason: The free tier already covers all my workout and multi-sport logging, and I can easily invite five friends from my padel or soccer groups to unlock Pro instead of paying out of pocket.
objection: All my workout friends and kudos are already on Strava, and with five free meal scans a week plus the five-friend referral perk, I have no reason to buy a subscription.
would_change_my_mind: If my entire sports crew migrated over and the AI coach offered sport-specific conditioning and recovery insights that Strava lacks.
